title: Microbial diversity of formate-ethanol and acetate-ethanol chain elongation systems
description: This project investigates the microbial diversity and community composition of anaerobic chain elongation systems using formate-ethanol and acetate-ethanol as co-substrates. The V3-V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was sequenced to compare microbial community structures associated with the production of four-carbon to six-carbon carboxylic acids. The study aims to understand microbial community responses to different co-substrates and to support the biological upgrading of carbon dioxide-derived formate and ethanol into higher-value carboxylic acids.
